description: Header file defining the CUDAHooksInterface class for CUDA functionality in PyTorch, including virtual methods for CUDA operations and error handling.

classes.name: CUDAHooksInterface
classes.description: An interface class for CUDA-related functionalities, with virtual methods for querying CUDA capabilities and managing CUDA resources.

methods.name: ~CUDAHooksInterface
methods.description: Destructor, default implementation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes CUDA state; throws error if CUDA library is not loaded.

methods.name: getDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Returns default CUDA generator; throws error if CUDA library is not loaded.

methods.name: getNewGenerator
methods.description: Creates a new CUDA generator; throws error if CUDA library is not loaded.

methods.name: getDeviceFromPtr
methods.description: Gets device from pointer; throws error if CUDA library is not loaded.

methods.name: isPinnedPtr
methods.description: Checks if pointer is pinned; returns false.

methods.name: hasCUDA
methods.description: Returns false; indicates CUDA support.

methods.name: hasCUDART
methods.description: Returns false; indicates CUDART support.

methods.name: hasMAGMA
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: hasCuDNN
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: hasCuSOLVER
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: hasCuBLASLt
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: hasROCM
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: hasCKSDPA
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: hasCKGEMM
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: nvrtc
methods.description: Returns reference to NVRTC; throws error if CUDA is not available.

methods.name: hasPrimaryContext
methods.description: Checks for primary CUDA context; throws error if CUDA library is not loaded.

methods.name: current_device
methods.description: Returns -1.

methods.name: getPinnedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Returns allocator for pinned memory; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: getCUDADeviceAllocator
methods.description: Returns CUDA device allocator; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: compiledWithCuDNN
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: compiledWithMIOpen
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: supportsDilatedConvolutionWithCuDNN
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: supportsDepthwiseConvolutionWithCuDNN
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: supportsBFloat16ConvolutionWithCuDNNv8
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: supportsBFloat16RNNWithCuDNN
methods.description: Returns false.

methods.name: versionCuDNN
methods.description: Returns long; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: versionRuntimeCuDNN
methods.description: Returns long; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: versionCuDNNFrontend
methods.description: Returns long; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: versionMIOpen
methods.description: Returns long; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: versionHipBLASLt
methods.description: Returns long; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: versionCUDART
methods.description: Returns long; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: showConfig
methods.description: Returns string with CUDA configuration details; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: batchnormMinEpsilonCuDNN
methods.description: Returns double; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: cuFFTGetPlanCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Returns int64_t; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: cuFFTSetPlanCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Sets plan cache max size; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: cuFFTGetPlanCacheSize
methods.description: Returns plan cache size; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: cuFFTClearPlanCache
methods.description: Clears plan cache; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.

methods.name: getNumGPUs
methods.description: Returns 0.

methods.name: isGPUArch
methods.description: Checks GPU architecture; throws error if CUDA is not loaded (ROCM only).

methods.name: deviceSynchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes CUDA device; throws error if CUDA is not loaded.
